title: Conversation 2026-10-29: favourite and recent repos in srs-web

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner is almost always loading the same few repositories in the srs-web editor and finds them slowly. They asked for a list of recently opened repositories with a star to mark favourites, shown first. GitHub first, then local folder and file. Filed as a holon and built through /ship.
